# tidepool

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.11+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.11%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)
[![Version 0.4.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.4.0-green.svg)](https://github.com/)

Cron-style job scheduling for async Python applications.

tidepool lets you run recurring tasks inside your existing event loop, using familiar cron expressions and plain `async def` functions. There are no separate worker processes, no threads to manage, and no external broker to deploy. Jobs start, run, and stop alongside the rest of your application.

## Features

- Schedule jobs with standard five-field cron expressions.
- Built on `asyncio`, so jobs never block your loop.
- Embed the scheduler directly in your app.
- Full type hints for a better editor experience.

## Requirements

Python 3.11 or later.

## Installation

```bash
pip install tidepool
```

## License

Released under the [MIT License](LICENSE).
